qs.s: Il a sorti son ___ pour allumer sa cigarette.
qs.en: He took out his lighter to light his cigarette.

qs.s: As-tu un ___ ? Je n'arrive pas à allumer les bougies.
qs.en: Do you have a lighter? I can't light the candles.

qs.s: Elle a acheté ___ briquet rouge dans une boutique.
qs.en: She bought a red lighter at a shop.

qs.s: Il a laissé tomber ___ briquet sur la table.
qs.en: He dropped the lighter on the table.

qs.s: Un ___ orange s'est posé sur la fleur.
qs.en: An orange butterfly landed on the flower.

qs.s: Dans le jardin, les enfants couraient après un ___ jaune.
qs.en: In the garden, the children were running after a yellow butterfly.

qs.en: Coming back home, he found a parking ticket stuck under his windshield wiper.

qs.en: She had to pay a fine because of a parking ticket left on her windshield.

qs.en: In swimming class, she is learning to swim the butterfly stroke.

qs.en: He won the gold medal in the 200-meter butterfly.

qs.s: ___ papillon vole de fleur en fleur dans le jardin.
qs.en: The butterfly flies from flower to flower in the garden.

qs.en: I saw a magnificent butterfly with blue wings.

qs.s: Avec sa robe longue et ses bijoux étincelants, elle dégageait un vrai ___ hollywoodien.
qs.en: With her long dress and sparkling jewelry, she exuded real Hollywood glamour.

qs.s: Le magazine consacre un article au ___ des soirées de gala parisiennes.
qs.en: The magazine devotes an article to the glamour of Parisian gala evenings.

qs.s: ___ glamour de cette actrice impressionne tout le monde.
Cette robe de soirée a vraiment ___ glamour.
qs.en: This evening dress really has glamour.
